name: French Press
summary: Full-bodied, textured coffee brewed by full immersion — forgiving and low-equipment.

steps.title: Preheat
steps.instruction: Rinse the French press with hot water to preheat the glass, then discard the water.

steps.title: Add coffee
steps.instruction: Add 30g of coarsely ground coffee to the empty press.

steps.title: Pour and bloom
steps.instruction: Pour in 500ml of hot water, saturating all the grounds evenly.
steps.tip: A crust of grounds will form on top — that's expected.

steps.title: Steep
steps.instruction: Place the lid on top without plunging. Let the coffee steep undisturbed.

steps.title: Break the crust
steps.instruction: Gently stir the surface to break up the crust of grounds, then skim off any foam.

steps.title: Plunge and serve
steps.instruction: Slowly press the plunger straight down, then pour immediately to stop extraction.
steps.tip: Don't let brewed coffee sit on the grounds — pour it all out right away.
